items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: The only piano player that I knew around Donaldsonville was Monnie Jones and Claiborne William Darden.

ctx.x: Well, the only thing that I have music on is Real Red Wagon. He sent me that. And something else, you know how they write those piano copies. The only backup there is another tune.

Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know. I ain't gonna tell nobody. Was that it? Do you remember? Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was a good number. Yeah. There were a lot of good tunes. Did you ever know a piano player from Donaldsonville called Fishing Braid? Nope. His right name was Richard Barrett. I think...

I heard of Tony Cal or something like that. Cy Cal. You ever heard of Cy Cal or something? Tell me he's holding me. He got... Mm-mm. The only piano player that I knew around Donaldsonville was Monnie Jones and Claiborne William Darden. We call her Bella. Bella. Mm-hmm. I just wanted because...
